description: Bob is a 20-year Bethlehem firefighter, President of the Pennsylvania Professional Firefighters Association (PPFFA), small business owner, and high school baseball coach fighting to give working class Pennsylvanians a voice in Washington Nazareth, PA – Tonight, firefighter Bob Brooks won the Democratic nomination for Pennsylvania’s 7th Congressional District and will take on vulnerable Republican Congressman […]
